ANKRD1+ / PECAM1+ endothelial cells were localized to the alveolar parenchyma, near SFTPC+ alveolar type 2 (AT2) cells.

RNA ISH for SEMA6A (red) and PECAM1 (white), demonstrating co-localization of SEMA6A within PECAM1+ endothelial cells in term (n = 3) and preterm (n = 5) uninjured controls, with decreased expression in BPD (n = 2) and BPD + PH (n = 4).
